request.prompt: A landmark sports arena for a star athlete: a sleek dome with an orange basketball-like roof pattern, a giant trophy statue at the entrance, flag poles. Stylized cartoon game asset in the spirit of premium Apple Arcade city builders and Pixar-like toy worlds: chunky soft-beveled shapes, slightly exaggerated proportions, hand-painted textures, vibrant natural colours, clean readable silhouette from a high three-quarter camera. Single object only on a flat square base no larger than its footprint, no terrain, no people, no text, no logos, neutral lighting without baked shadows. Game-ready economical topology, textured PBR.
